mis_merges.label: Oil
subjects: rates positioning (5s30s curve steepener at 62bp, 4.40% yield level holding on a close)
mis_merges.why: Two of the three cards under 'Oil' are rate-curve/yield-level trades with no oil content, so an editor scanning labels would never see a standalone rates theme and the oil label itself would misrepresent its own card mix.

notes: Capex-cycle label is split across two near-identical wordings, and 'Oil' silently absorbs unrelated rates trades, both of which would mislead an editor picking lead themes from labels alone.
